facts.business: VK Global Industries Limited operates a hydroponic farming facility producing fresh, residue-free vegetables for the Delhi-NCR market through digital and e-commerce channels.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Board is considering an expansion plan directed at a meaningful improvement in the scale of operations to meet rising market demand

key_risks: Constraints on water, soil and climate affecting food production
Execution risk in scaling up hydroponic operations
Market demand uncertainty for value-added and processed offerings
